role: The minecart item (ids 328, 342, 343, 407, 408, 422): places an EntityMinecart on a rail on right click, and carries a dispenser behavior.
scope_reason: world.conf minecarts = off: carts cannot be placed; the Java onItemUse body starts with the WorldConf.minecarts gate and returns false.

members.name: minecartType
members.note: the type is carried by the item id (328 rideable, 342 chest, 343 furnace, 407 tnt, 408 hopper, 422 command block)

members.name: onItemUse
members.note: the world switch returns false before the rail check; the native has no minecart placement path and the base Item.onItemUse also answers false

notes: lane/itemuse: iu-off-s1 uses it with world.conf's switch off (used on the ground and in the air: nothing happens).
